items.source:
Interface for auditable entities. Allows storing and retrieving creation and modification information. The changing
instance (typically some user) is to be defined by a generics definition.
items.translation: 可审计实体的接口。允许存储和检索创建及修改信息。变更实例（通常为某个用户）应由泛型定义来指定。

items.source: U - the auditing type. Typically some kind of user.
items.translation: U - 审计类型。通常是某种用户。

items.source: ID - the type of the audited type's identifier
items.translation: ID - 被审计类型的标识符类型
